name: Boutwell Steel Company
old_description: At Boutwell Steel, we supply pipe, steel, and metal materials for ranches, contractors, fabricators, and property owners throughout Dripping Springs and the surrounding Hill Country. Alongside steel sales, we build custom steel driveway gates and offer in-house welding and custom fabrication tailored to each project. From raw materials to finished pieces, everything is built with a focus on durability, function, and craftsmanship.
about:
Boutwell Steel Company operates from Dripping Springs, Texas, serving the surrounding Hill Country region. The company supplies pipe, steel, and metal materials while also building custom steel driveway gates and providing in-house welding and fabrication services. Ownership details and founding year are not publicly disclosed.

The company maintains a full-service welding and fabrication facility capable of handling projects ranging from heavy equipment welding to structural steel work. In addition to custom fabrication, Boutwell Steel stocks a range of products including structural pipe in multiple diameters, bollards, base plates, square and rectangular tubing, flat bar, angle iron, round bar, C-channel, landscape steel, Corten steel, expanded metal, steel plate, stainless steel, and various hardware. The facility offers delivery, cutting, and fabrication services alongside material sales.

Primary customers include ranches, contractors, fabricators, and property owners throughout Dripping Springs and the Hill Country. The company's gate products are marketed as “Texas Edition Gates,” reflecting a regional focus on agricultural and residential property needs.

Boutwell Steel emphasizes durability, function, and craftsmanship in its finished pieces, positioning its work as tailored to each project’s requirements.
